skill.gourmet2.nail_punch.desc: Hold to wind up a drilling punch combo; the longer the charge, the more hits land.
skill.gourmet2.nail_gun.desc: A machine-gun barrage of nail punches across a forward cone.
skill.gourmet2.fork.desc: Four parallel piercing stabs that make the target bleed.
skill.gourmet2.knife.desc: A clean horizontal sweep that cuts rather than bludgeons.
skill.gourmet2.leg_knife.desc: Hold to coil a kick, release to throw one crescent of cutting wind. The longer the charge, the bigger and stronger it is.
skill.gourmet2.flying_fork.desc: Hold to fire vacuum prongs one after another for as long as the key is held; release to stop. Damage and size are set in the power settings.
skill.gourmet2.flying_knife.desc: Hold to fire crescent waves one after another for as long as the key is held; release to stop. Damage and size are set in the power settings.
skill.gourmet2.intimidation.desc: Toggle: the Appetite Demon looms over you and your body is boosted (speed, strength, jump), while clearly weaker foes are pressured. Foes of a similar or higher Capture Level are unaffected.
skill.gourmet2.demon_form.desc: Toggle: become the Appetite Demon. Your attributes are greatly raised, which also raises your Capture Level. Only clearly weaker foes are pressured.
skill.gourmet2.ki_release.desc: Toggle: radiate Gourmet Cell ki that presses back everything nearby. Output is set in the power settings; higher output drains more Appetite.
skill.gourmet2.food_immersion.desc: Meditate to awaken the Gourmet Cells: refills Appetite and empowers every skill.

message.gourmet2.must_be_grounded: You must be standing on the ground.
message.gourmet2.already_awakened: Your Gourmet Cells are already awake.
message.gourmet2.armor_reduced_combo: The target's armour cut your combo from %s to %s hits.

gui.gourmet2.skill_slots.title: Skill Hotbar
gui.gourmet2.skill_slots.hint: Pick a skill on the left, then click a slot. Click a slot with nothing picked to clear it.
gui.gourmet2.combat_style.title: Combat Style
combat_style.gourmet2.fist.desc: Three-hit combo, a dash dodge and a guard.
combat_style.gourmet2.acrobatic.desc: Fast punches and kicks, both arms and legs. Hold jump while attacking: standing (or still rising) it launches the target into the air, on the way down it spikes them back down.
combat_style.gourmet2.swift.desc: The fastest style. Light knife-hand chops with quick lunges, and a finisher that lands twice.
combat_style.gourmet2.capoeira.desc: Dance-fighting, and the hardest-hitting style. Three forms, one key each: kicks (a crescent, the spinning armada, the queixada), open-hand strikes, and spins built around a full cartwheel. Hold jump while attacking: standing (or still rising) it launches the target, on the way down it spikes them down.
